messages:
alex: Quick RFC — proposing SDK/HTTP headers to hint routing: `X-RW-Region`, `X-RW-Tier`, and optional `X-RW-Debug` for tracing. Goal: let clients prefer region/tier without changing global account routing.

mira: +1 for region hint. We should make it explicit that hints are 'soft' (policy can override). Console needs a toggle to allow customers to opt-in to header-based overrides.

jamal: Concern: header spoofing. If a customer can set `X-RW-Tier=dedicated` from the client, they'll attempt to bypass reserved capacity rules. We need server-side enforcement — validate header against API key/project entitlements.

alex: Yup, entitlements check planned. Idea: headers used only for routing decision tree, then dropped and logged. No billing change implied unless entitlement matches.

kevin: Small SDK ergonomics note: mobile/JS SDKs often prefer an options object param rather than low-level headers. Eg `client.request({model, region: 'eu', tier: 'dedicated', debug: true})` -> SDK maps to headers. Avoid exposing raw header plumbing to most users.

natalie: Quotas/limits: if header requests cause higher SLA (dedicated) we must ensure quota enforcement still applies. If we route to dedicated due to hint but entitlement is not present, return 403 or fallback to shared with a clear telemetry tag.

mira: On fallback: prefer transparent fallback to compatible model variant + emit metric `route.fallback.{reason}` and include `route.debug` in trace id. Customers should be able to opt-in to receiving fallback notifications in Console.

alex: Example curl prototype: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "X-RW-Region: eu-west-1" \
  -H "X-RW-Tier: dedicated" \
  -H "X-RW-Debug: 1" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-13b"}'
```

jamal: Implementation notes: treat `X-RW-Debug` as ephemeral. Only allow when API key is flagged for debug (internal users or support tokens). Otherwise drop and log a misuse metric.

kevin: CDN caches: headers will bust some caches. For high-volume embedding endpoints we need to be careful — maybe use query param mapping at edge or normalize header set for caching.

natalie: Telemetry: add `routing.hint_source` attribute (sdk-header, sdk-param, console-override) and `routing.outcome` (honored, overridden, rejected, fallback). These should be surfaced in per-route dashboards.

mira: UX: Console -> Traffic controls -> Toggle to allow user headers, plus a staged rollout (account-level default OFF). Add a table showing how many requests used header hints and how many fell back.

alex: Agreed. Next steps: PR for SDK mapping + server entitlement check. I'll draft policy matrix for allowed combos (region x tier) and fallback ladder (model variant -> lower tier -> region).

routing-bot: CI: integration tests passed for header-parsing branch (build #784). :white_check_mark:

jamal: One more: ensure logs include anonymized `routing.reason` for debugging but never log full customer header values for PII.

kevin: If everyone's good I'll open the SDK issue and server-side ticket. Quick thumbs? :thumbsup:

mira: :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:
